newsitem.title: UK: Jardine Matheson sees steady 1997 trading.
newsitem.headline: Jardine Matheson sees steady 1997 trading.

text.p: Jardine Matheson Holdings Limited said on Tuesday it expected a steady trading performance in 1997 but said the overall earnings outlook for 1996 had been affected by the weak Thai stock market.
The company also said there would be a provision of some $50 million from the disposal of certain restaurant operations in Australia.

The weak Thai stock market had impacted its life assurance business leading to a poorer performance from Jardine Pacific Holdings Limited and Jardine Fleming Group Limited had also had a difficult second half with less favourable financial markets in Asia, the company said.

Most of its businesses had, however, performed in line with expectations, it said, and its overall financial position would be strengthened by the significant increase in the value of its property interests at the year end.
